description: Search Federal Register rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents: title, type, agencies, publication and effective dates, citation, abstract and the official document link. Narrow by agency (for example foreign-assets-control-office, industry-and-security-bureau, state-department), type or date.

agency.description: Federal Register agency slug, for example foreign-assets-control-office, treasury-department, industry-and-security-bureau, state-department, homeland-security-department.

since.description: Only documents published on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

term.description: Words to find, for example "entity list additions".

type.description: RULE, PRORULE (proposed rule), NOTICE or PRESDOCU (presidential document).

name: search_federal_register
title: Search the Federal Register
